headline: Fireworks AI breach via cloud provider exposes Notion customer chat data
summary: Fireworks AI disclosed a new security breach after attackers compromised a third-party cloud provider and accessed its development machines. Notion later said the breach at its AI infrastructure provider, Fireworks, exposed Notion AI chat transcripts in a small number of workspaces, as Fireworks' customer data exposure widened.

claims.statement: Fireworks AI disclosed a new security breach after attackers compromised a third-party cloud provider and accessed its development machines.

sources.quote: Fireworks AI discloses new breach after cloud provider hack
AI infrastructure startup Fireworks has disclosed a new security breach in which attackers accessed its development machines after breaching a third-party cloud provider.
Inference biz pins latest breach on cloud provider and LLMJacking miscreants

claims.statement: The Fireworks breach exposed Notion's customer AI chat transcripts in a small number of workspaces.

sources.quote: Notion says Fireworks breach exposed customer AI chat transcripts
Notion, the digital workspace platform, disclosed that a security breach at its AI infrastructure provider, Fireworks AI, exposed Notion AI chat transcripts in a small number of workspaces.

claims.statement: The incident marks a second breach for Fireworks AI, with the scope of customer data exposure widening.

sources.quote: Fireworks AI gets burned twice as customer data exposure widens
